# s2

```clojure
(def Fixture-methods
  {run
   {:does "do the one deed"
    :in #{:input}
    :out :none
    :scratch #{:one :two :three}
    :how "the mechanism"}})
```

```clojure
(def Fixture-data
  {:input {:type string :as input :lives :external :holds "what comes in"}
   :one   {:type Array :as one :lives run :holds "the first buffer"}
   :two   {:type Array :as two :lives run :holds "the second buffer"}
   :three {:type Array :as three :lives run :holds "the third buffer"}})
```
